method: The only place names get_strategy may say (06 § rigging and area advice, AD-2, principle 7): named public grounds taken from dist/data/charter-grounds.json labels, which come from names the landings publish. Anything else, including every dist/regions/<id>/search-plans.json spot name, is dropped. general_depth_ft is the charter-grounds depth_ft rounded to 5 ft (nominal survey values, datum unverified: a broad band, not a chart depth). description is a broad direction in words; no entry carries a coordinate, radius or waypoint, and tests/test_advisor_tools.mjs fails if one does.

morro-bay.name: Pecho Rock
morro-bay.description: Reef country around the Pecho Rock landmark south of Point Buchon; the rock itself is a landmark, not a fishing spot. Find structure on your sounder.

morro-bay.name: Diablo coast
morro-bay.description: Rocky coast south of Point Buchon, outside the Diablo Canyon security zone and the Point Buchon MPAs. Check the closures before you set up.

morro-bay.name: Morro Bay coast
morro-bay.description: The inshore reefs off Morro Bay and Estero Bay. A broad area, not one reef.
